command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$projects=@('CampusNetwork-for-perf','CampusNetwork-for-perf_02','CampusNetwork-for-perf_04','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08'); foreach(`$p in `$projects){ '===== '+`$p+' ====='; foreach(`$n in @('PE1','PE2','PE3')){ foreach(`$i in @('Ethernet1/0/1','Ethernet1/0/2')){ `$c='display interface '+`$i; `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output; if(`$o -notlike 'Error:*'){ `$m=`$o -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { `$_ -match 'utility rate' }; `$n+' '+`$i+': '+(`$m -join ';') } } } }"
